title: Factual Recall Circuit Benchmark: A Standardized Evaluation Set for Knowledge Localization Claims

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Knowledge localization is safety-relevant for editing or suppressing factual claims. Inconsistent benchmarking prevents practitioners from trusting localization methods. A standardized benchmark directly enables method comparison for safety-critical knowledge editing.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building the 100-fact dataset requires verifying GPT-2-Small completions across five categories. Running causal tracing and attribution patching are established methods in TransformerLens. Moderate complexity: dataset curation is labor-intensive but not technically hard.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 100 facts, five categories, two localization methods, per-category scoring. The dataset curation and two-method comparison adds breadth. Could be narrowed to 50 facts and two categories to fit 30 hours better.
